topics.title: Choose the outcome
topics.text: Prepare a read-only plan, or authorize initialization only after the agent verifies live readiness. Client Discovery preparation never executes either workflow.

topics.title: Connect your repository
topics.text: Create a private consumer from the template, clone it, and sign in to the intended GitHub CLI account. Browser login and CLI login are separate.

topics.title: Reuse the existing operator
topics.text: Ask the authorized operator for its existing protected profile reference. Do not create another server, pool or App. Enter only a path/reference, never the profile's credentials.

topics.title: Name your application
topics.text: Choose the consumer identity deliberately. The slug scopes new resources; the display name is what people see.

topics.title: Set code and installed-app names
topics.text: Use an explicit Java application namespace. The short installed-app name has a 12-character limit; keep names consistent across locales unless you supply exact localized names.

topics.title: Keep artwork and existing data safe
topics.text: Retain the current theme. Supply an image directory or deliberately retain template artwork. A fresh isolated app preserves every older app and database; a rename or migration is separate work.

topics.title: Check GitHub repository access
topics.text: Open repository Settings → Actions → General. The pinned template Actions must be permitted, and the operator needs repository administration and private required-check support. The agent binds main protection only after genuine CI exists.

topics.title: Save the App's repository selection
topics.text: In organization Settings → GitHub Apps, configure the existing shared App. Add only this repository under selected repositories, preserve existing selections and save. Obtain owner consent now if your account cannot do this.

topics.title: Resolve package ownership
topics.text: Inspect the repository-derived frontend/backend packages before approving writes. Preserve unrelated packages by default. Replacement needs exact IDs, owners, all-version counts and explicit old-image-loss consent.

topics.title: Prepare the two DNS names
topics.text: Select the existing project that owns the DNS zone. Check A/AAAA/CNAME and wildcard conflicts. Preserve matching records. Either prepare the two records yourself or authorize only missing-record creation using the operator's protected reference.

topics.title: Choose the initial account
topics.text: Supply identity only. The agent generates distinct local/staging/production passwords into protected files later. An account named admin still has the standard USER authority.

topics.title: Choose the backup destination
topics.text: Same-server storage cannot survive loss of that server. Accept that risk explicitly or supply an already supported operator destination. A downloaded rehearsal copy is not an automatic off-server backup service.

topics.title: Set the recovery schedule
topics.text: Choose an operator-supported daily time and IANA timezone. Retention stays 30 days, staging stays unscheduled, and the production timer is enabled only after real initialized retrieval and isolated restoration pass.

topics.title: Bound mechanical allocation
topics.text: The agent may choose only genuinely unused ports within these bounds, preserving existing workloads. Changing a local port also updates every related launch/proxy/configuration reference.

topics.title: Prepare your trusted workspace
topics.text: Prepare JDK 21, Node 24/npm 12, Docker/Compose and trusted VS Code Java/Gradle/debugger extensions. Allow import to finish, but do not start an old-identity database. Actual personalized IDE launches still need a verified unattended tool path.

topics.title: Review the exact preparation
topics.text: Review the names, boundaries and references before authorizing actions. These attestations do not prove provider access or runtime success; the agent independently verifies them.

topics.title: Authorize application and CI work
topics.text: Check only actions you actually authorize for this exact consumer. No checkbox authorizes an upstream publication, new host, privileged-source upgrade or database reset.

topics.title: Authorize isolated release preparation
topics.text: Limit changes to the declared DNS names, approved namespace and available capacity. Production must promote the exact successful staging pair without rebuilding.

topics.title: Authorize recovery and exact cleanup
topics.text: Live database restoration and password resets remain excluded. Optional package deletion applies only to the exact listed packages/versions; no list means no deletion authority.

topics.title: Sign the bounded request
topics.text: Enter your authorized GitHub account and an explicit UTC validity window. Signing is an explicit developer action, never automatic approval or renewal. Any later edit requires another final review.

topics.title: Review preparation for initialization
topics.text: Review and save the preparation revision in Client Discovery. Invoke /initialize-project with this production project ID in a fresh agent chat. The initializer captures the reviewed workbook and verifies live readiness.

prerequisites: Private consumer created/cloned; exact repository and fresh/resume boundary entered.
Intended GitHub account is authenticated in the protected CLI store.
Repository administration, private Actions and required-check plan support confirmed.
Existing shared App has this selected repository; owner/browser consent saved.
Existing protected operator profile is available; host trust/source/receipt and capacity are the operator's responsibility.
Correct DNS zone/project authority is available; names/conflicts and chosen record-creation mode resolved.
Package names inspected; no conflict, same-consumer resume, or exact replacement rows and digest-loss acknowledgement recorded.
Conditional `delete:packages` authorization completed, **or** `registry_delete_auth` is `not-required` because no deletion is requested.
Local tools, Docker and trusted VS Code/Java import/extension consent prepared.
Identity, artwork, account, backup destination/risk/schedule and allocation bounds answered.
approvals: Personalize this consumer's approved identity/assets and generate protected distinct credentials.
Build/test, launch the real native/IDE/browser flows and allocate only approved unused local ports.
Register this exact repository through the existing reviewed operator at an idle maintenance point; validate before reactivation and preserve existing registrations.
Create scoped consumer commits/branches/PRs/pushes and configure main with the genuine `CI gate`, strict PRs, zero approving reviews and administrator enforcement.
Use only the declared DNS names, existing host/namespace and permitted free ports; preserve matching records and block conflicts.
Prepare isolated consumer databases/volumes/networks/controller/TLS and publish only the public controller certificate variable.
Run real Deploy staging and promote its exact successful immutable pair with Deploy production at the same selected source.
Explicitly provision the approved users, verify both real HTTPS/browser flows, retrieve and isolated-restore an initialized production dump, then enable only the approved production schedule.
Remove only exact task-owned scratch containers/temporary transfer or credential files; retain protected backups and all unrelated resources.
If and only if exact replacement rows are present and approved above, replace only those packages/versions; otherwise no old image/package deletion.
